_comment: Single source for model tiers (ADR 0011 with its addenda, docs/process/rollen.md). tools/sync_agent_models.py writes the resolved id into the `model:` line of each agent file, and a fixed effort into its `effort:` line, and fails when a tier floor below is broken. Change a tier here, run the script, commit both.
rules: The acceptance judge never runs on the model that wrote the change; because the judge is on tier spitze, the implementer never runs on spitze.
The critic is always at least one tier above the test designer.

Floors (owner, 2026-10-25): acceptance judge, critic and architecture reviewer always run on spitze, the highest reasoning tier (today Fable 5.1; a successor model is adopted only by changing the tier table above). If a subagent cannot start the spitze model they fall back to stark, never to mittel or guenstig; rather no verdict than a weak one (the owner then reads the report). No review role (reviewer, security-reviewer, frontend-reviewer) runs below stark. tools/sync_agent_models.py --check enforces these floors.
The implementer runs on tier stark (Opus 5.5) with the effort chosen by the ticket's risk (owner, 2026-10-25): low medium, medium high, high xhigh. Never tier spitze (the judge's tier).

effort._comment: Reasoning effort per role: low, medium, high, xhigh, max. A string is fixed and written into the agent file by tools/sync_agent_models.py; the implementer's map is keyed by the ticket's Risk field and passed by the main session at start (Agent tool `effort`; skill brief-implementer). Owner 2026-10-25.
